faq: How is your on-time claim verified?
Each committed part lot anchors to a signed ledger event with a verified delivery time — traceable from material order to the plant.
Do you support emergency and planned maintenance parts?
Yes, both; every committed delivery, planned or rush, runs under the same on-time gate.
